name: AlwaysTrust
description: Removes the annoying untrusted domain and suspicious file popup

settings.label: Untrusted domain popup
settings.description: Remove the untrusted domain popup when opening links

settings.label: Dangerous download popup
settings.description: Remove the 'Potentially Dangerous Download' popup when opening links

settings.label: No delete safety
settings.description: Removes the enter server name requirement when deleting a server

settings.label: Confirm modal
settings.description: Should a "are you sure you want to delete" modal be shown?

gaps: "No delete safety" and "Confirm modal": Qord's Delete Server dialog has no plugin surface yet, so it still asks for the server name.
notes: Qord asks before opening any link from a message (Discord asks only for untrusted domains); "Untrusted domain popup" skips that question. Qord has no "Potentially Dangerous Download" popup, so the "file" setting has nothing to remove.
